description: This file defines types, functions, and rendering logic for processing Markdown into an intermediate representation (IR), including handling of styles, links, tables, and spoilers.

classes.name: ListState
classes.description: Tracks the type ('bullet' or 'ordered') and index of list items during rendering.

classes.name: LinkState
classes.description: Represents the state of a hyperlink, including its href and label start position.

classes.name: RenderEnv
classes.description: Holds the environment for rendering, including the stack of list states.

classes.name: MarkdownToken
classes.description: Represents a token parsed from Markdown, with type, content, children, and attributes.

classes.name: MarkdownStyleSpan
classes.description: Defines a span of styled text with start/end positions and style type.

classes.name: MarkdownLinkSpan
classes.description: Defines a span of linked text with start/end positions and href.

classes.name: MarkdownIR
classes.description: Intermediate representation of Markdown, including text, styles, and links.

classes.name: MarkdownTableData
classes.description: Represents table headers and rows as strings.

classes.name: MarkdownTableMeta
classes.description: Extends table data with a placeholder offset.

classes.name: RenderTarget
classes.description: Represents the current rendering state of text, styles, links, and open styles.

classes.name: TableCell
classes.description: Represents a table cell with text, styles, and links.

classes.name: TableState
classes.description: Tracks the current state of a table being processed, including headers, rows, and current cell.

classes.name: RenderState
classes.description: Aggregates rendering state, including text, styles, environment, table info, and options.

methods.name: createMarkdownIt
methods.description: Creates and configures a MarkdownIt parser instance based on options.

methods.name: getAttr
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value from a MarkdownToken.

methods.name: createTextToken
methods.description: Creates a text token with specified content based on a base token.

methods.name: applySpoilerTokens
methods.description: Injects spoiler tokens into a list of tokens.

methods.name: injectSpoilersIntoInline
methods.description: Processes inline tokens to inject spoiler open/close tokens based on delimiters.

methods.name: initRenderTarget
methods.description: Initializes a new RenderTarget object.

methods.name: resolveRenderTarget
methods.description: Resolves the current render target, considering table cell context.

methods.name: appendText
methods.description: Appends text to the current render target.

methods.name: openStyle
methods.description: Opens a style span at the current text position.

methods.name: closeStyle
methods.description: Closes a style span, finalizing its position.

methods.name: appendParagraphSeparator
methods.description: Adds paragraph separation unless inside a list or table.

methods.name: appendListPrefix
methods.description: Adds list item prefix based on list type and index.

methods.name: renderInlineCode
methods.description: Renders inline code content with style.

methods.name: renderCodeBlock
methods.description: Renders a code block with style.

methods.name: handleLinkClose
methods.description: Finalizes a link span when a link is closed.

methods.name: initTableState
methods.description: Initializes a new TableState object.

methods.name: finishTableCell
methods.description: Finalizes a table cell, closing styles.

methods.name: trimCell
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a cell and adjusts styles and links accordingly.

methods.name: appendCell
methods.description: Appends a table cell's content, styles, and links to the render state.

methods.name: appendCellTextOnly
methods.description: Appends only the text of a cell, ignoring styles.

methods.name: collectTableBlock
methods.description: Collects current table data into the collectedTables array.

methods.name: appendTableBulletValue
methods.description: Appends a bullet point or label for table data in bullet list mode.

methods.name: renderTableAsBullets
methods.description: Renders a table as a list of bullet points.

methods.name: renderTableAsCode
methods.description: Renders a table as a markdown code block.

methods.name: renderTokens
methods.description: Recursively renders a list of Markdown tokens into text and styles.

methods.name: closeRemainingStyles
methods.description: Closes all open styles at the end of rendering.

methods.name: clampStyleSpans
methods.description: Clamps style spans to a maximum length.

methods.name: clampLinkSpans
methods.description: Clamps link spans to a maximum length.

methods.name: mergeStyleSpans
methods.description: Merges adjacent style spans of the same style.

methods.name: resolveSliceBounds
methods.description: Calculates the intersection of a span with a slice range.

methods.name: sliceStyleSpans
methods.description: Slices style spans to a specified range.

methods.name: sliceLinkSpans
methods.description: Slices link spans to a specified range.

methods.name: sliceMarkdownIR
methods.description: Slices a MarkdownIR to a specified range.

methods.name: markdownToIR
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to MarkdownIR.

methods.name: markdownToIRWithMeta
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to MarkdownIR with metadata, handling spoilers and tables.

methods.name: chunkMarkdownIR
methods.description: Splits a MarkdownIR into chunks of specified size.
